verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for a structured llms.txt index at developers.mailerlite.com, and a second llms.txt exists at www.mailerlite.com. Their content summarizes the API docs (batching, webhooks, campaigns, CLI) and product features, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The /.md docs variant returned 404 and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the .md probe 404'd), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use of the llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Install and use the MailerLite CLI to manage subscribers, campaigns, automations, and more from your terminal.
Three editors, a drag and drop editor, a distraction-free Simple editor and a custom HTML editor with live preview.
